passages.text: Beloved, this is now my second letter to you. Both of them are reminders to stir you to wholesome thinking by recalling what was foretold by the holy prophets and commanded by our Lord and Savior through your apostles.
passages.sermon:
I am writing to you, beloved.
This is my second letter to you.
I want to remind you of important things.
I want to stir up your sincere mind.
I want you to remember the words spoken before.
The holy prophets spoke these words.
Your apostles gave you commands from our Lord and Savior.
These reminders help you think in a pure and honest way.
passages.original: Ταύτην ἤδη ἀγαπητοί δευτέραν ὑμῖν γράφω ἐπιστολήν ἐν αἷς διεγείρω ὑμῶν ἐν ὑπομνήσει τὴν εἰλικρινῆ διάνοιαν μνησθῆναι τῶν προειρημένων ῥημάτων ὑπὸ τῶν ἁγίων προφητῶν καὶ τῆς τῶν ἀποστόλων ὑμῶν ἐντολῆς τοῦ Κυρίου καὶ Σωτῆρος

passages.text: Most importantly, you must understand that in the last days scoffers will come, scoffing and following their own evil desires.
passages.sermon:
Peter is writing to Christians.
Peter warns them about the last days.
In the last days, certain people will appear.
These people are called scoffers.
Scoffers will mock and make fun of the truth.
Scoffers will follow their own evil desires.
You must understand this is most important.
passages.original: τοῦτο πρῶτον γινώσκοντες ὅτι ἐλεύσονται ἐπ’ ἐσχάτων τῶν ἡμερῶν ἐν ἐμπαιγμονῇ ἐμπαῖκται κατὰ τὰς ἰδίας ἐπιθυμίας αὐτῶν πορευόμενοι

passages.text: “Where is the promise of His coming?” they will ask. “Ever since our fathers fell asleep, everything continues as it has from the beginning of creation.”
passages.sermon:
Scoffers will come in the last days.
They will ask a question.
They will say, “Where is the promise of His coming?”
They will point out that our fathers have died.
They will say that everything stays the same.
They will claim that nothing has changed since the beginning of creation.
passages.original: καὶ λέγοντες Ποῦ ἐστιν ἡ ἐπαγγελία τῆς παρουσίας αὐτοῦ ἀφ’ ἧς γὰρ οἱ πατέρες ἐκοιμήθησαν πάντα οὕτως διαμένει ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς κτίσεως

passages.text: But they deliberately overlook the fact that long ago by God’s word the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and by water, through which the world of that time perished in the flood.
passages.sermon:
Scoffers choose to ignore something important.
They do this on purpose.
Long ago, God spoke.
By God’s word, the heavens came into existence.
God’s word also formed the earth.
The earth was formed out of water.
The earth was also formed through water.
God’s word made this happen.
By these means, the world of that time was destroyed.
Water flooded the world.
The world perished in the flood.
passages.original: Λανθάνει γὰρ αὐτοὺς τοῦτο θέλοντας ὅτι οὐρανοὶ ἦσαν ἔκπαλαι καὶ γῆ ἐξ ὕδατος καὶ δι’ ὕδατος συνεστῶσα τῷ τοῦ Θεοῦ λόγῳ δι’ ὧν ὁ τότε κόσμος ὕδατι κατακλυσθεὶς ἀπώλετο

passages.text: And by that same word, the present heavens and earth are reserved for fire, being kept for the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.
passages.sermon:
God spoke and created the world.
God’s word still has power.
The present heavens exist because of God’s word.
The present earth exists because of God’s word.
God’s word keeps the heavens and earth for a purpose.
God has set aside the heavens and earth for fire.
God keeps them until the day of judgment.
On that day, God will judge.
On that day, God will destroy ungodly people.
passages.original: οἱ δὲ νῦν οὐρανοὶ καὶ ἡ γῆ τῷ αὐτῷ λόγῳ τεθησαυρισμένοι εἰσὶν πυρὶ τηρούμενοι εἰς ἡμέραν κρίσεως καὶ ἀπωλείας τῶν ἀσεβῶν ἀνθρώπων

passages.text: Beloved, do not let this one thing escape your notice: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.
passages.sermon:
Beloved, I speak to you now.
Do not forget this one important truth.
God is the Lord.
Time is different for the Lord.
One day for the Lord is like a thousand years.
A thousand years for the Lord is like one day.
passages.original: Ἓν δὲ τοῦτο μὴ λανθανέτω ὑμᾶς ἀγαπητοί ὅτι μία ἡμέρα παρὰ Κυρίῳ ὡς χίλια ἔτη καὶ χίλια ἔτη ὡς ἡμέρα μία

passages.text: The Lord is not slow in keeping His promise as some understand slowness, but is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance.
passages.sermon:
The Lord always keeps His promise.
Some people think the Lord is slow.
The Lord is not slow.
The Lord is patient with you.
The Lord does not want anyone to perish.
The Lord wants everyone to come to repentance.
passages.original: οὐ βραδύνει Κύριος τῆς ἐπαγγελίας ὥς τινες βραδύτητα ἡγοῦνται ἀλλὰ μακροθυμεῖ εἰς ὑμᾶς μὴ βουλόμενός τινας ἀπολέσθαι ἀλλὰ πάντας εἰς μετάνοιαν χωρῆσαι

passages.text: But the Day of the Lord will come like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a roar, the elements will be destroyed by fire, and the earth and its works will be laid bare.
passages.sermon:
The Day of the Lord will come suddenly.
It will come like a thief.
The heavens will vanish with a loud noise.
Fire will destroy the elements.
The earth will be exposed.
Everything done on the earth will be revealed.
passages.original: Ἥξει δὲ ἡμέρα Κυρίου ὡς κλέπτης ἐν ᾗ οἱ οὐρανοὶ ῥοιζηδὸν παρελεύσονται στοιχεῖα δὲ καυσούμενα λυθήσεται καὶ γῆ καὶ τὰ ἐν αὐτῇ ἔργα οὐχ εὑρεθήσεται

passages.text: Since everything will be destroyed in this way, what kind of people ought you to be? You ought to conduct yourselves in holiness and godliness as you anticipate and hasten the coming of the day of God, when the heavens will be destroyed by fire and the elements will melt in the heat.
passages.sermon:
God will destroy everything in this way.
You must ask what kind of people you should be.
You should live in holiness.
You should live in godliness.
You should look forward to the day of God.
You should hurry that day’s coming.
On that day, God will destroy the heavens with fire.
On that day, the elements will melt in the heat.
passages.original: Τούτων οὕτως πάντων λυομένων ποταποὺς δεῖ ὑπάρχειν ὑμᾶς ἐν ἁγίαις ἀναστροφαῖς καὶ εὐσεβείαις προσδοκῶντας καὶ σπεύδοντας τὴν παρουσίαν τῆς τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμέρας δι’ ἣν οὐρανοὶ πυρούμενοι λυθήσονται καὶ στοιχεῖα καυσούμενα τήκεται

passages.text: But in keeping with God’s promise, we are looking forward to a new heaven and a new earth, where righteousness dwells.
passages.sermon:
God made a promise.
We trust this promise.
We look forward to a new heaven.
We look forward to a new earth.
Righteousness lives in this new heaven and new earth.
passages.original: καινοὺς δὲ οὐρανοὺς καὶ γῆν καινὴν κατὰ τὸ ἐπάγγελμα αὐτοῦ προσδοκῶμεν ἐν οἷς δικαιοσύνη κατοικεῖ

passages.text: Therefore, beloved, as you anticipate these things, make every effort to be found at peace—spotless and blameless in His sight.
passages.sermon:
Beloved, you are waiting for these things to happen.
God will bring a new heaven and a new earth.
Righteousness will live there.
Because you expect this, make every effort.
Be found by God in peace.
Be spotless.
Be blameless in His sight.
passages.original: Διό ἀγαπητοί ταῦτα προσδοκῶντες σπουδάσατε ἄσπιλοι καὶ ἀμώμητοι αὐτῷ εὑρεθῆναι ἐν εἰρήνῃ

passages.text: Consider also that our Lord’s patience brings salvation, just as our beloved brother Paul also wrote you with the wisdom God gave him.
passages.sermon:
Our Lord is patient.
His patience brings salvation.
God gave Paul wisdom.
Paul is our beloved brother.
Paul wrote to you with this wisdom.
Paul wrote that the Lord’s patience brings salvation.
passages.original: Καὶ τὴν τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν μακροθυμίαν σωτηρίαν ἡγεῖσθε καθὼς καὶ ὁ ἀγαπητὸς ἡμῶν ἀδελφὸς Παῦλος κατὰ τὴν δοθεῖσαν αὐτῷ σοφίαν ἔγραψεν ὑμῖν

passages.text: He writes this way in all his letters, speaking in them about such matters. Some parts of his letters are hard to understand, which ignorant and unstable people distort, as they do the rest of the Scriptures, to their own destruction.
passages.sermon:
Paul is our beloved brother.
God gave Paul wisdom.
Paul writes to you with this wisdom.
Paul writes about these things in all his letters.
Some parts of Paul's letters are hard to understand.
Ignorant people distort these hard parts.
Unstable people also distort these hard parts.
They twist Paul's letters.
They twist the rest of the Scriptures in the same way.
They do this to their own destruction.
passages.original: ὡς καὶ ἐν πάσαις ταῖς ἐπιστολαῖς λαλῶν ἐν αὐταῖς περὶ τούτων ἐν αἷς ἐστιν δυσνόητά τινα ἃ οἱ ἀμαθεῖς καὶ ἀστήρικτοι στρεβλοῦσιν ὡς καὶ τὰς λοιπὰς γραφὰς πρὸς τὴν ἰδίαν αὐτῶν ἀπώλειαν

passages.text: Therefore, beloved, since you already know these things, be on your guard so that you will not be carried away by the error of the lawless and fall from your secure standing.
passages.sermon:
You are beloved.
You already know these things.
Be on your guard.
Do not let the error of lawless people carry you away.
Do not fall from your secure standing.
passages.original: Ὑμεῖς οὖν ἀγαπητοί προγινώσκοντες φυλάσσεσθε ἵνα μὴ τῇ τῶν ἀθέσμων πλάνῃ συναπαχθέντες ἐκπέσητε τοῦ ἰδίου στηριγμοῦ

passages.text: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To Him be the glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.
passages.sermon:
Jesus Christ is our Lord and Savior.
You must grow in grace.
You must grow in knowledge of Jesus Christ.
Jesus Christ deserves all glory now.
Jesus Christ deserves all glory forever.
Amen.
passages.original: αὐξάνετε δὲ ἐν χάριτι καὶ γνώσει τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν καὶ Σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα καὶ νῦν καὶ εἰς ἡμέραν αἰῶνος Ἀμήν
